definitions: A large Eurasian maple tree with a rounded crown, lobed leaves, and winged seeds.
A North American plane tree, Platanus occidentalis, with mottled bark and spherical fruit clusters.
A fig tree, Ficus sycomorus, native to the Middle East and parts of Africa, bearing edible fruit.
examples: We planted a young sycamore in the garden.
The carpenter worked with sycamore wood.
